_comment: URBAN NEON — the NYXUS Daily Driver palette. Staged over skel ONLY when the bake runs with NYX_EDITION=daily; the shared/alien accent.json stays 'prism' and is never touched. Hex values are sampled from the mockups approved 2026-08-01 (docs/assets/daily-driver/) and specified in docs/DAILY_DRIVER_BRINGUP_PLAN.md §5. Active must stay 'urban-neon'. follow_wallpaper is LOCKED OFF — the palette is the identity, it does not drift with the wall. Apply with: nyxus-apply-accent urban-neon

_glass._comment: Frosted glass + corner-bleed material. Corner-bleed is an owner-required signature: panel corners fade to transparent so the neon city reads through the chrome. Delivered with compositor layer blur plus widget alpha, NOT per-widget CSS blur, which GTK/eww cannot do.
